Black metal bolt

Internal ID: BoltBlackmetal | Type: Bolt | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Black metal x2, Feathers x2

Introduction. Black metal bolts are ammunition for crossbows and are the next direct upgrade from Iron bolts.

Availability. • It is unlocked after building or using a Black forge and is also crafted at one.
